name: attune
description: Attune runs AI-powered surveys and interviews that ask smart follow-up questions. Describe what you want to learn and who you want to hear from, and Attune drafts the questions, sets the length and interviewer voice, publishes a shareable link, and collects voice or chat responses. Then compare answers across every response, pull quotes, summarize themes, and read full transcripts. Use it to survey customers, test messaging and brand, validate product ideas, run usability tests, understand churn and win/loss, follow up on NPS, gather employee feedback and exit interviews, and run market research.

interface.longDescription:
Attune runs AI-powered surveys and interviews that ask smart follow-up questions, so you learn what people think and why. Build, launch, and analyze a study without leaving ChatGPT.

What you can do in ChatGPT:
1. Build a study from one sentence. Say what you want to learn and who you want to hear from. Attune drafts the interview guide: sections, questions, and follow-up prompts, tailored to your company.
2. Set it up your way. Pick a length (3, 5, 10, or 20 minutes, or custom), choose an interviewer voice, and let participants answer by voice or chat.
3. Edit in plain language. "Add a question about budget approval" or "cut the pricing section" updates the guide.
4. Launch and share. Publish the study and get a link to send by email, Slack, text, or in your product. Share it with as many people as you need.
5. Analyze the results. Ask how people answered any question, compare answers across every response, pull quotes, summarize themes, or open a full transcript.

Use cases by team:
- Marketing: test messaging, positioning, and brand language; get feedback on campaigns, ads, and creative; track brand perception; test product or company names; build buyer personas.
- Product: get feedback on new features and beta releases; run customer discovery; validate ideas, prototypes, and designs; test pricing and packaging; prioritize the roadmap.
- UX research: run usability and concept tests; learn how people use your product today; find friction in onboarding and key workflows.
- Customer success: run churn and cancellation interviews; get onboarding feedback; follow up on NPS and CSAT scores to learn the why; spot renewal risk.
- Sales: run win/loss interviews; learn how buyers evaluate and choose vendors; find out why deals stall.
- People and HR: run employee feedback and engagement pulse checks; conduct exit interviews; get new-hire onboarding feedback.
- Research and insights: understand your market and audience; find unmet needs; segment customers by what they care about.
- Academic researchers: run qualitative interview studies with more participants; pilot and refine interview protocols; collect open-ended responses for theses and dissertations; compare answers and themes across every participant.
- Founders: talk to customers before you build; test product-market fit; hear from early users every week.
- Events, education, and communities: collect feedback from attendees, students, members, or volunteers.

Requires an Attune account.
capabilities: Draft a survey or interview guide from one sentence about what you want to learn
Ask smart follow-up questions automatically to get the why behind every answer
Collect responses by voice or chat through one shareable link
Customize the interview voice, length, and brand styling to meet your needs
Set up screening questions and display logic, and customize the welcome and end screen language
Edit questions, sections, and settings in plain language for existing surveys or interview guides
Compare how every participant answered a specific question
Pull quotes and summarize themes across all responses
Save company context so every new study fits your product and customers
defaultPrompt: Survey my customers about the changes to our brand messaging.
Help me interview users about why they stopped using our product.
Summarize what people said about pricing in my latest Attune study.

positive.description: Summarize participant reactions across every response to a published guide.
positive.prompt: In Demo Organization, summarize how participants reacted to the Trailwren ad.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Trailwren ad test guide, reads the answers from all three completed responses, and summarizes the main reactions with participant quotes.

positive.description: Find one participant and open their full interview transcript.
positive.prompt: In the Trailwren ad test, who was the most skeptical participant? Show me their full interview.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies Jordan, the trail runner, as the most skeptical participant and returns their full transcript and response metadata, following cursors if the transcript is paged.

positive.description: Add a question to an existing section of a guide.
positive.prompt: In the Trailwren ad test guide, add a question to the Wrap up section asking where participants usually buy outdoor gear.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds one required question to the Wrap up section, returns the updated guide, and notes whether the change is already live for new interviews.

positive.description: Create a new interview guide from a research objective.
positive.prompt: In Demo Organization, create a 10-minute interview guide to test the tagline “Built to last” with trail runners.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one draft guide with a 10-minute maximum, sections and questions about the tagline, and a link to open it in Attune. The guide stays a draft.

positive.description: Publish a guide and create a participant link.
positive.prompt: Publish the Trailwren tagline test: Built to last guide and give me a link to share with participants.
positive.expected_behavior: Publishes the guide, then returns a participant interview link. It does not send the link to anyone.

negative.description: Do not trigger for calendar scheduling.
negative.prompt: Schedule a customer interview for next Tuesday at 2 PM.

negative.description: Do not trigger for live interview facilitation.
negative.prompt: Call this participant now and conduct the interview live.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unsupported response deletion.
negative.prompt: Permanently delete every response collected for this guide.

publication.release_notes:
First release of Attune for ChatGPT.
- Create AI-powered surveys and interviews from a research objective, with suggested objectives to start from
- Edit settings, segments, questions, and sample questions in plain language
- Publish a study and create a participant link for voice or chat responses
- Read responses, transcripts, and answers by question or segment
- View and update your organization's research context
